Leakages add money back into the circular flow each round

questions.explanation: The trap claim is: Every round re-spends the full injection, so national income grows by the same amount each round without limit. In fact Only part of each round's income is re-spent - the rest leaks away as saving, tax and imports - so each round adds a geometrically smaller amount and national income settles at a multiple of the injection.

questions.answer: Only part of each round's income is re-spent - the rest leaks away as saving, tax and imports - so each round adds a geometrically smaller amount and national income settles at a multiple of the injection.
questions.explanation: Shrinking rounds are the deciding habit: subtract the leakage from each round first, then re-spend only what is left.
